responsibility: This definition module declares a small standard-stream I/O layer that maps character Read, Write, and Error operations onto the process’s default file descriptors and also exposes terminal mode controls. It belongs to the gm2 runtime console I/O subsystem and provides the public interface for switching buffered versus unbuffered operation and turning terminal echo on or off.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the console I/O pair, declaring Read/Write/Error plus buffering and echo control procedures, while hiding the FIO delegation, raw-mode switching, and termios handling implemented in IO.mod.
